title: a deterministic gate that overrides a PASS audit narrative leaves no failure class, so the cycle gets no repair round
summary: Found root-causing cycle 1700 (2026-09-26). The auditor's narrative said PASS; EGPS forced FAIL with red_count=2 and named the two red predicates. decideAfterAuditFail then logged ORCHESTRATOR_AUDIT_REPAIR_DECLINED ('audit declared no failure class; nothing to base a retry on') and the cycle went straight to retro. The red predicate ids and their evidence files (runs/cycle-N/acs-red-evidence/) are exactly the information a repair round needs.
fix: When a deterministic gate forces FAIL over a PASS narrative, derive the failure class from the gate (for example egps_red with the red predicate ids and evidence paths) so the repair decision has a class to route on. Decide by policy whether a gate-forced FAIL earns one repair round.
acceptance: an audit whose narrative is PASS and whose EGPS is red records a failure class naming the red predicates (test)
the repair decision for that class is policy-driven, not a literal (test)
